name: 3-chlorophenmetrazine
summary: 3-Chlorophenmetrazine (3-CPM; code name PAL-594) is a recreational designer drug with stimulant effects. It is a substituted phenylmorpholine derivative, closely related to better known drugs such as phenmetrazine and 3-fluorophenmetrazine (3-FPM; PAL-593).

pharmacology.text: The drug has been shown to act as a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA) with additional weak serotonin release.
